profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Have worked as a software engineer, entrepreneur, organizer, and connector for over 10 years. My passion lies in solving problems by connecting the right people and technology.

Exploring new ideas and finding new opportunities are key to success. Continuous improvement, great attitude, and collaboration are what creates great products, great experiences, and consequently great success.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Solving problems with software utilizing multiple tools and programming languages such as: 
- JavaScript
- .NET
- C#
- SQL
- Angular JS
- React
- Redux

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Helped convert BedandBreakfast.com into a modern, reliable, secure, and scalable marketplace for BnBs.

- ASP.NET MVC
- .NET
- C#
- JavaScript
- Entity Framework
- SQL
- Backbone JS
- Knowckout JS

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: I founded and developed TheTechMap.com site to help the tech and startup community find each other and to showcase this great community of starters and doers to the world.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Helped the company enhance the performance of the ticketcity.com site by implementing a cache mechanism using Memcached. This resulted in fewer trips to the database, and also recommended and di the following: optimizing image sizes, combining and minifying CSS and JavaScript files.
•	Architected and coded software tools and applications to help both internal and external clients manage ticket purchases, orders and inventory. All of these internal applications where developed using ASP.NET MVC, and the WebAPI.
•	Helped junior developers learn and work with legacy applications and software defects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Work on multiple web application projects for companies such as McCoy’s and BearingPoint using .NET Widows forms and Web forms for web applications. 
•	Later we started using MVC for all of our web applications.
•	Contributed to the design and development of an online system for an application used by the Motor Vehicle - State of Montana using ASP.MVC and various web controls from Telerik.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Worked very closely with the project managers to help them design and create custom web applications to facilitate the work of the company’s loan officers. Also, about 6 months after starting the project, was made responsible for DHI’s intranet. 
•	Converted many classic ASP applications to .NET Web forms and also made several changes to the intranet to increase performance and functionality.
•	A major contribution at this company was with the development of .NET Windows applications which allowed loan officers to price loans automatically and then sell them to banks and investors as packaged investments. This application reduced the time it took loan officers to price the loans from 4 to 6 hours to only 45 minutes. The application connects to several banks to get current loan rates and automatically price these loans based in the current rate and other specific parameters entered by loan officers.

volunteerExperiences.description: Founded this group in 2010 to help local developers and designers connect with the business and entrepreneurial community. The group grow to over 2,000 members and each meeting over 110 people attended.
Our meetup's goal is to promote diversity in tech by showcasing startups, ideas, and people who are part of a minority group.
